'''2022 MPC Justin Desai DS ROPS V''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Desai]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire (V)|V10-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Ralltiir Operations (V) Desai DS.txt |Download]]
